setup: Stock selection-only AI. The 2026 public prospect cache and pre-draft ESPN order were restored in memory on the fresh post-draft league snapshot. Future classes use projected draft order and the same starting team strategy and rosters. Evaluation uses 2025–26 standings and roster minutes for all four assignments. No season or trade execution is simulated.

tuning.method: Reach grid minimizes equal-weight differences in median absolute gap / 4, reach-5 rate / 0.15, and reach-10 rate / 0.10 in the four pick bands. Historical fit years and two generated classes choose a candidate; 2022–2025 and the third generated class are a separate check. Other weights are one-at-a-time sensitivity checks around the best reach-grid setting.
